content: Free-tier deployment topology (secondary sources 2026): split static frontend (Vercel/Netlify/Cloudflare Pages/Render static, free) + Python API (Render free web service, Fly.io, or Vercel serverless). Cross-origin by design so FastAPI CORSMiddleware with explicit origins is mandatory. Free tiers spin down after ~15 min idle (cold starts); fine for a teaching demo. Platform choice still open per PROJECT.md - architecture is host-agnostic: any static host + any API host works.
